messages:
marie-support: Hi @devin-eng — escalated from Acme. They report embeddings/rerank endpoint returning 400 with "DimensionMismatch" on a batched payload (4 items). Also saw a billing spike at the same minute and latency for some requests jumped to ~5s. Need repro steps: request ids, curl, logs, debug bundle.

devin-eng: Thanks — can you paste the exact request_id(s) and a minimal curl we can run? Also time window and which model they asked for.

marie-support: Request ids: req_acme_20260304_01, req_acme_20260304_02. First seen 2026-03-04T15:12:09Z. Customer said they called model "redwood-embed-1024" but client expects 1024 dims and our response sometimes contains 1536. Sample (sanitized):

```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-REDACTED" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" \\n  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-1024","input":["docA","docB","docC","docD"]}'
```

devin-eng: Trying to repro on staging. Quick Q: did they use the official SDK or a direct HTTP client behind a proxy? gzip + bad content-length could cause partial reads.

log-bot: debug_bundle created: dbg_1965432130 for req_acme_20260304_01 (expires in 7 days)

sophie-sre: If the routing layer accidentally routes to a 1536-dim variant, the client will get a payload with different dimensionality. Also check whether the rerank path does any post-processing that could change expected dims.

marie-support: Customer says they use Acme-internal proxy and a slightly older SDK. They did explicitly enable gzip on their side. They provided this truncated response body: 

```json
{"error":"DimensionMismatch","expected":1024,"got":1536,"request_id":"req_acme_20260304_01"}
```

devin-eng: OK — repro plan: 1) run an identical request against staging with same headers (including Content-Encoding: gzip), 2) produce a debug bundle with X-Debug: true, 3) compare model routing logs and kernel selection for those request_ids. If we can reproduce, check fallback policy that might select a 1536-dim model variant.

devin-eng: Staging curl to run (replace token):

```bash
curl -v -X POST https://staging.api.redwood-inference.com/v1/embeddings \\n  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-staging-REDACTED" \\n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\n  -H "Content-Encoding: gzip" \\n  --data-binary @payload.json \\n  --compressed

# payload.json:
# {"model":"redwood-embed-1024","input":["a","b","c","d"]}
```

sophie-sre: Also ask Acme for their SDK version and whether they set an explicit "model" override or used model aliasing. Alias could map to a different-dim model if misconfigured.

marie-support: I asked for SDK version and proxy logs; customer sent SDK logs (attached) and consent for us to run a staging repro.

log-bot: new request logged: req_internal_1965432170 (staging run by devin-eng)

devin-eng: I ran the staging curl and reproduced a 400 DimensionMismatch. Server log snippet (sanitized):

```
[2026-03-04T15:13:30Z] req_internal_1965432170 INFO routing selected_variant=redwood-embed-1536 reason=fallback_capacity
[2026-03-04T15:13:30Z] req_internal_1965432170 ERROR embeddings: dimension_mismatch expected=1024 got=1536
[2026-03-04T15:13:30Z] req_internal_1965432170 DEBUG kernels selected=quant-opt-v2 sequence_len=128
```

marie-support: Noted — customer billing spike likely from repeated retries while proxy didn't surface 400 quickly. Looping in billing/product if there are charge anomalies.

devin-eng: Next steps for eng: 1) check routing policy that permitted fallback to 1536-dim variant for requests explicitly targeting redwood-embed-1024, 2) add strict model-dim validation earlier in the request path to return a clearer error before billing, 3) coordinate a quick rollback or routing rule patch if misrouting is confirmed.

sophie-sre: I'll add a temporary guard in routing to prevent dimension-variant fallbacks for pinned model names.

marie-support: Thanks all. I'll update Acme with repro steps + staging request_id (req_internal_1965432170) and ask them to check for duplicate retries. Will escalate billing if they show unexpected charges.

devin-eng: Keeping thread open until we confirm routing fix deployed on staging and can reproduce not failing. Will post follow-ups.
